B.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM/common denominator for two denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to express fractions over the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step only subtracts numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing differing denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers by subtracting numerators over a common denominator or by subtracting whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction of two fractions with the same denominator (a/b − c/b)
A step subtracts after conversion to a common denominator
A step subtracts mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting numbers (conversion/common denominator) without performing the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as an equivalent mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states the fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or to an integer (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing subtraction without any reduction or final-form statement
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers

A.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two existing fractions without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or common denominator for two denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to express both fractions over the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing denominator alignment

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with a common denominator or decomposed into whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting numbers (conversion/common denominator) without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states the result is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies an integer result
exclusion_criteria: Only performing subtraction without any reduction or final-form statement
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers

C.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert number forms
skills.definition: Convert between mixed numbers, integers, and improper/equivalent fractions to enable direct subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., a b/c → (ac+b)/c)
Rewriting an integer as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 → 15/5)
Simplifying a given fraction representation before operating (e.g., 34/10 → 17/5)
exclusion_criteria: Finding an LCM or common denominator across two different denominators (tag S02 instead)
Performing the subtraction operation itself once forms are aligned (tag S03 instead)
Reducing a final fraction to lowest terms (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) and create equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Computing an LCM of denominators to choose a common denominator
Scaling numerators/denominators to rewrite fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Cases where denominators are already equal and no common-denominator work is needed (tag S03 instead)
Converting mixed numbers/integers to fractions without addressing differing denominators (tag S01 instead)
Reducing/simplifying the final result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with a common denominator or aligned whole/fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracting numerators over a shared denominator (a/b − c/b)
Subtracting after converting to equivalent fractions with a common denominator
Subtracting by separating whole and fractional parts when denominators match
exclusion_criteria: Any step whose main purpose is to create equivalent forms (tag S01 or S02 instead)
Any step whose main purpose is to reduce/simplify the result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or rewriting as an integer or mixed number when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Reducing a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Stating that a fraction is already in lowest terms
Rewriting an improper fraction as a mixed number or recognizing a whole-number result
exclusion_criteria: Initial conversions done to enable subtraction (tag S01 instead)
Common-denominator construction (tag S02 instead)
The subtraction computation itself (tag S03 instead)
